Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Blurred Lines
programme.desc: 24-year-old Apoorva is caught in a tangle of relationships when she has an epiphany that she is attracted to her best friend who has come to dress her up to meet prospective in laws.

programme.title: Karjdar Bhola
programme.desc: In a small village, Bhola and Komal, a struggling couple, face financial hardships. Bhola, a simple laborer, and Komal, his smart and beautiful wife, are burdened by a loan from Seth ji, a corrupt man who harasses Komal. Bhola mistakenly believes Komal is involved with Seth ji, leading to a deep misunderstanding. Eventually, the truth comes to light, allowing them to overcome their challenges and find happiness together.

programme.title: Bindu
programme.desc: Bindu, a little school-going girl, and his older brother Gaurav live in the hilly regions where they barely make their day’s end meet. Gaurav works in the early shifts as a paperman, delivering news on his cycle, and finds time in between for Bindu to take her to school. A stitched-up overused shoe, an old ragged school bag, Bindu becomes the epitome of being a struggling unprivileged kid while Gaurav holds on to his pair of old sandals, the same pair of dress, and an old cycle.

programme.title: Certitude
programme.desc: This movie shows the story of Arjun, a smalltown boy from Dehradun who decides to move to Mumbai for his further studies. So in his new surroundings, he is unable to trust anyone until he finds someone whom he can finally rely on throughout his journey in Mumbai.

programme.title: Broken Stars
programme.desc: An astrologer who has a fake beard is just like his profession. He is confused about the stars and how it determines anyone's future, he tricks people daily but He is worried about his daughter suffering from a disease, then one day as it happens his past somehow connects with his present which determines his future. it is a philosophical journey of a man who constantly questions the existence of sheer weirdness of the whole connection of our stars with lives and his realization

programme.title: Betu
programme.desc: Sparsh(12), or Betu, as his mother calls him, is a happy, mischievous boy, who hates milk, who is conscious about his hairstyle and who is too impatient to wait for the lunch hour to eat his best friends tiffin. Sparsh’s life changes when his best friend’s mother dies in an accident. That being his first direct exposure to death, it shakes him up. The unpredictability of life hits him and his mind inadvertently goes to his own mother, who he realizes is not immune from the fickle composition of life. The fear of separation takes away the nonchalance from his attitude and he is no longer the carefree boy he used to be. He starts observing and watching over his mother like a guardian. As he prepares to meet the reality, he is summoned at the destination where his fears lie.

programme.title: Bharam
programme.desc: A Hindi drama short film about an executive visiting a house to give away a Mercedes won by a housewife in a lucky draw and the confusion that follows.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: A psychopath Biriyani Delivery boy barges into the house of a young lady and threatens to kill her. The story revolves around this confrontation between these two characters. The climax of the story turns out to be something very unexpected.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: "A young woman returns home after a prolonged absence, enjoying a warm bond with her mother but strained ties with her father. Reconnecting with a previously misjudged acquaintance, she faces revived conflicts with her mother. Tasked with overseeing tuition students, an unforeseen incident alters their lives permanently. Her homecoming: a blessing or a curse?"

programme.title: Barking Bruno
programme.desc: Barking Bruno sheds light on the reality of modern life, where we often prefer pets over parents, viewing them as burdens. Rohit, content with his dog Bruno, contrasts sharply with his treatment of his father, Mr. Mehra, who feels neglected. However, when Mr. Mehra meets Bruno, his life takes an unexpected turn, albeit temporarily

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Ritesh and Yami are just a day away from their marriage, and ritesh makes a confession which may affect their upcoming relationship, or maybe not?

programme.title: Chashmadeed
programme.desc: A 60 YO woman lives with her entitled 30-year-old son and his wife. She is a doting mother to him, and like any mother, thinks of her son as ideal. One morning, she starts having a strange issue with her eyes, as her vision keeps getting blurred in erratic spasms, like a camera going out of focus and back. Upon the recommendation of her 23-year-old hip and woke neighbor, she sets out to visit an eye clinic by herself. The solution offered at this eye clinic more than clears her blurry vision.

programme.title: Bed Tea
programme.desc: Anything can Happen Over a Bed Tea. An unexpected tale of a Rainy Morning which asks a question on a long time going on the existence of hidden evil behavior in relationships.

programme.title: Bepar
programme.desc: A flourishing young Indian immigrant, happily married to a caring Pakistani husband, appears to lead a flawless life. However, the challenges of being in an interfaith marriage and adjusting to a foreign society might prove overwhelming.

programme.title: Bita Hua Pal
programme.desc: The film delves into the universal question of love and compatibility. It follows the journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Bully
programme.desc: In This Psychological Thriller, A girl who is holding her brother hostage must confront the darker aspects of her life and come face to face with the truth.

programme.title: Best Friend
programme.desc: This story centers on Manav, a wealthy and aggressive man, who is deeply possessive of his girlfriend, Shreya. When Shreya, alone at home, invites Manav over for the first time, a misunderstanding between her and Manav's best friend leads Manav, in a fit of rage, to murder both Shreya and his guard.

programme.title: Chaar Pandrah
programme.desc: A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stanger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the strangers wife.

programme.title: Beshak
programme.desc: Story of a couple where the wife couldn’t find the difference between dream and reality and doubt enters into the relationship!

programme.title: Black Coffee
programme.desc: Film director Tara uncovers her sister Vanya's betrayal in a relationship and decides to take dramatic action. In a jaw-dropping twist, Tara stages their deaths in a short film. The lines between fiction and reality blur as Tara invites her real sister for coffee after the shoot, leaving the audience questioning what is real.

programme.title: Beyond Failing
programme.desc: This film captures intricate nuances of student stress, competition the so called rat race, parent child relation and purposeless living vs. purposeful living.

programme.title: Blame Game
programme.desc: A woman sits alone on a beach, lost in thought, until a stranger joins her, sparking a conversation that reveals a story about love, relationships, and the bitterness they can sometimes bring. She describes a once-loving bond that, over time, turned painful, leaving lasting scars.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Ticket Please
programme.desc: Manohar Kadam, a voluntary retired man, tries hard to establish a meaningful connection with his only son Aditya but fails. Later he follows his friend Professor's advice and tries to connect with his son through a smartphone. The short film follows the Journey of Father and Son relationship in this Digital Era.

programme.title: Chand Saanse
programme.desc: Here is a story of a woman, NAYAN, She is in the waiting room of a hospital where her father-in-law is admitted. In the waiting room she sees suffering of other people. It looks the waiting room is meant waiting for death. She meets an old man who has just lost his wife but he is not aware of it. He keeps on talking about his wife as if she is still alive. That makes NAYAN to ask a question. What is the difference between life and death? Knowing about it or being unaware about it?

programme.title: Bumbhaiyya
programme.desc: The movie shows that how a common man is affected by the inter-religious conflicts that happen and how in the end he understands the real truth.

programme.title: Countless
programme.desc: A man who decides to spend the night with a woman ends up spending countless nights with the same woman at the same time. Could this be punctuality, love, lust, or something completely different?

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young man who is struggling with his career and has to face tough situations on the financial front. In a state of dejection/ despair he has a dialogue with his inner self. His negative self talks him into addictions and resorting to drugs or committin suicide (escapist attitude) He usually feels at home in the company of his negative self and seeks solace here. Yet somewhere he is dissatisfied and constantly looking for his positive self, whom he has only abandoned

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Cheater
programme.desc: Love is blind, they say. And, sometimes, quite literally! How many of us are guilty of forgiving our partners once too often for their hurtful actions? When it comes to a cheating spouse, however, you would think there was no scope for forgiveness.

programme.title: Chashmishq
programme.desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

programme.title: Budhwaar
programme.desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Divorce Celebration
programme.desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

programme.title: Prem Patra
programme.desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?

programme.title: Goals
programme.desc: As Meera, our pretty in pink protagonist comes back to Bombay after spending several months apart from her beau Ranbir, the circumstances force them to evaluate the basis of their relationship. This film is a deep dive into a young adult's core problems of emotional dishonesty and preference of style over substance.

programme.title: Dubki
programme.desc: Dubki is a story based on a true incident of a female constable in male-dominated law enforcement. Despite being a tough and dominant constable at the Lalkurti police station, Ganga Yadav was troubled several times by SHO Durgesh Mishra. Ganga complained about it to the IPS officer and asked for a transfer; however, he refused to help her. The female constable was left with no other choice but to take justice into her own hands.

programme.title: Firni
programme.desc: The next-door neighbors are having a fight and they send their rude 14-year-old daughter Firni to keep her busy.

programme.title: Dwand
programme.desc: Ruby, a lower-middle-class girl was made to believe that she is beautiful, intelligent, and different and that she deserves a worthy husband. She completed her studies and wanted to be a career girl. However, the marriage happened contrary to her expectations with a traditional man Vivek of the similar lower middle-class strata. After giving birth to a girl child she revolted and joined an advertising company to shape up her career. Here begins the nightmare.

programme.title: Duty
programme.desc: Different classes in society are intertwined, with each person's actions impacting others. When individuals from various classes fulfil their responsibilities, stability is achieved. This story explores fairness and the expression of duty among people from different social strata.

programme.title: Cycle Of Sorrows
programme.desc: Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father’s regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he’s caused?

programme.title: Electric Piya
programme.desc: A high school girl brings a new bulb for her study lamp. The bulb is anthropomorphic and he is exultant and joyful for having the luck of lighting for her. As he lights, he falls in love with the young girl.

programme.title: Didi!
programme.desc: Imagine waking up to an annoying alarm sound. Familiar? Now imagine waking up to someone else's alarm! Why isn't anyone shutting it? Find out what happens when an annoyed brother wakes up to his sister's loud alarm and storms to her room only to find it empty.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Foul
programme.desc: Against the setting of a journey to Thailand, Ayush, a lustful businessman, possesses both the capability and cleverness to be unfaithful to his wife and shatter her aspirations of moving to Canada. Yet, the question remains: Can he thwart her pursuit of realizing her dreams?

programme.title: Jackosn The Paying Guest
programme.desc: A cop visits a haunted village, loves Viji, and must survive a week in a ghostly bungalow to marry her.

programme.title: Super Taxi
programme.desc: Shiva purchases a vintage car and realises that it is possessed. Can Shiva unearth the mystery behind it?

programme.title: Kakuda
programme.desc: In cursed Ratodi, a missed ritual invites Kakuda’s wrath, unleashing horrific consequences at a fateful hour.

programme.title: Jackosn The Paying Guest
programme.desc: A cop visits a haunted village, loves Viji, and must survive a week in a ghostly bungalow to marry her.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

programme.title: Consecration
programme.desc: After the alleged suicide of her priest brother, Grace travels to the remote Scottish convent. As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

programme.title: Cold Skin
programme.desc: In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: Suffering from amnesia, a young man trying to discover his true identity is kidnapped by an underground crime organization and turned into a ruthless assassin

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: Deep in the ice of the antarctic, a team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated, super soldiers with supernatural powers who were able to fly & destroy

programme.title: Nefarious
programme.desc: A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. The killer surprises the psychiatrist with his claim that he is a demon who wants the execution to go forward and claims that before their brief tie together is over, the doctor will commit three murders by day's end

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: Six girlfriends, a deep cave expedition going horribly wrong, suffocating miles under the surface of Earth, breed of predators smells their skin.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Untraceable
programme.desc: A FBI secret service agent, gets caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer who knows that people will log onto an "untraceable" website where he conducts violent and painful murders LIVE on the net. The more people who log on and enter the website, the quicker and more violently the victim dies.

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: Happiness comes knocking at the door on one of her most gloomy days during the pandemic. She embraces it & now it ain't easy to go

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Aakhri Sawari
programme.desc: Manish, a perfect husband and father, tormented by a mysterious parcel he receives from an anonymous sender has to make a life-changing decision. He shares his problems with his cab driver who listens patiently and tries to help. What the cab driver offers changes both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.title: Pilibhit
programme.desc: Inspired by true stories, Siraj, a righteous, impoverished flute maker, resides at the edge of the forests of Pilibhit, North India, where man-eating tigers thrive. His mounting livelihood pressures and tragedies corner him to take a drastic measure that threatens to tear down his values and a loved one.

programme.title: Do Cutting
programme.desc: An unforgettable love story about how a couple due to societal pressures on inter religion marriages hold up their lives.

programme.title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
programme.desc: Two flatmates, evidently from the gym-going North Indian breed of tinsel-town hopefuls, are warned about the 100 year old Witch that occasionally wanders around at night asking for an Onion. When an attractive neighbour knocks for help at midnight, their red-blooded fates unravel.

programme.title: Panic
programme.desc: A riveting psychological thriller that propels an aspiring actor's life into chaos when a toothache triggers an unfounded belief in oral cancer, setting off a catastrophic chain of events.

programme.title: Alvida
programme.desc: Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

programme.title: An Astrologer's Day
programme.desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

programme.title: Bena

Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. programme.title: Eelu Rani Bhag Gaye
programme.desc: Two teenagers running away from their home comes across a police officer who persuades them not to go, however Eelu & Rani have something else on their mind.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Orphan First Kill
programme.desc: After orchestrating a brilliant escape from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Esther travels to America by impersonating the missing daughter of a wealthy family. Yet, an unexpected twist arises that pits her against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous "child" at any cost.

programme.title: Hatching
programme.desc: In the most terrifying creature feature Hatching is a story about lovelessness that creates a monster. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, a 12 year old brings its strange egg home, she hides it and keeps it warm until it hatches. The creature that emerges becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare. What has she been hatching under everyone's noses that shocks them all?

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: Six girlfriends, a deep cave expedition going horribly wrong, suffocating miles under the surface of Earth, breed of predators smells their skin.

programme.title: The Descent Part 2
programme.desc: Refusing to believe her story about cave-dwelling monsters, the sole survivor of a spelunking exploration gone horribly wrong is forced to follow the authorities back into the caves where something awaits. The trapped group soon faces the hunger and savage breed of predators while trying to find a way out.

programme.title: Born To Fly
programme.desc: Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

programme.title: Consecration
programme.desc: After the alleged suicide of her priest brother, Grace travels to the remote Scottish convent. As she explores the wild cliffs and windswept beaches nearby, she uncovers what really happened with the help of Vatican priest, not only the murder but a disturbing truth about her own past which brings long-buried trauma to the surface.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Nefarious
programme.desc: A convicted serial killer on day of his scheduled execution gets a last minute court-ordered psychiatric evaluation. The killer surprises the psychiatrist with his claim that he is a demon who wants the execution to go forward and claims that before their brief tie together is over, the doctor will commit three murders by day's end

programme.title: Butcher's Crossing
programme.desc: Butcher’s Crossing is an epic adventure journey of a team of buffalo hunters that follows a young Harvard drop-out into the Colorado wilderness as he joins a team lead by Miller (Academy Award© winner NICOLAS CAGE) in search of a mythic herd of buffalo in 1874. The journey puts his life and sanity at risk. The adventure will get horrific, confrontation with dark will lead to descent of madness.

programme.title: Warhorse One
programme.desc: During the 2021 US military withdraw from Afghanistan, a SEAL team helicopter is shot down by a group of terrorists. A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief miraculously surviving the crash, while the rest of his team killed in action must guide a child to safety through a hostile Taliban armed forces and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel’s Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary. Ranveer’s passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we’ll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. programme.title: Are We Ready?
programme.desc: The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

programme.title: What The Future?
programme.desc: The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.

programme.title: Comfort Zone
programme.desc: Shaurya struggles with getting recognition for his efforts at work while Sanya debates shifting out of her home. Both of them help each other step out of their comfort zones and grow

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya shift in together, Sanya takes a gamble at work which impacts both of their lives.

programme.title: Emotion Or Logic
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya deal with the realization of having fallen for each other, they have to prioritize what is more important - emotions or logic?

programme.title: New Roles
programme.desc: Having finally admitted their feelings to each other, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend is over and they must get back to reality. With Shaurya up for a promotion and Sanya doubtful about her growth in this company, what is this new couple in for?

programme.title: Milestones
programme.desc: With appraisals around the corner, Shaurya and Sanya brace themselves for the unexpected. Eventually, Shaurya gets his first real lesson in team management and Sanya makes a crucial decision to help her get what she wants.

programme.title: Month-Iversary
programme.desc: To mark 3 months of being together, Shaurya convinces Sanya to organise something for their "monthiversary." However, things begin to get complicated as Shaurya finds himself working directly with Sanya - for the first time since they started dating.

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Shaurya eventually ends up at Akhil’s party but to his surprise does not feel like he belongs there. Meanwhile, Ratna invites Sanya to have a drink with her. Sanya still upset about Shaurya lying to her begins to feel better with Ratna and her friends. To her surprise Shaurya shows up there as well to save their monthi-versary. However, things seem to go in the opposite direction soon.

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: Shaurya’s presentation does not go as planned and he ends up overpromising samples to the client on a three day deadline. This leads to the team having to work round the clock. Meanwhile, Sanya makes a plan to take a break from work and convinces Shaurya to do go somewhere together. Both Shaurya and Sanya finally spend some quality time with each other but things take a turn when Shaurya gets a call from Vinod.

programme.title: Last Shot
programme.desc: Sanya decides to move back to her room. Shaurya isn’t happy about this. To make things worse Akhil is hard on him for overpromising and almost losing the client. Akhil demands that the team fixes the situation and gets them another chance.

programme.title: Broke Af
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the series: Ray and Nikhat are best friends and roommates who have just started their journey into independent adulthood. The central conflict is the classic "End of the Month" crisis—where your bank account is empty, but your social and survival needs are not.

programme.title: Mommy Knows Best
programme.desc: The episode centers on a surprise visit from Nikhat’s mother, which triggers a high-speed cleaning operation. For any young person living away from home, the "parental visit" is a performance of maturity, and Ray and Nikhat are determined to win an Oscar for "Most Responsible Adults."

programme.title: Friends Ya Followers
programme.desc: The episode explores the gap between digital perception and reality. Ray and Nikhat find themselves caught in a cycle of comparing their "boring" lives to the filtered, high-glamour lives of their peers on Instagram.

programme.title: On My Way
programme.desc: The episode follows a high-stakes day for both girls. Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) is trying to climb the corporate ladder and has a critical presentation, while Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) is dealing with the thrill and anxiety of a potential romantic connection. The title reflects the constant "hustle" and the physical and metaphorical state of being "in transit" in life.

programme.title: Now And Then
programme.desc: The episode is framed around a significant milestone: Nikhat’s (Aisha Ahmed) birthday. While birthdays are usually for celebrating, they often trigger a "Quarter-Life Crisis" where we compare our current reality to the versions of ourselves we imagined "then."

programme.title: Just Kiddin
programme.desc: The episode revolves around the nightmare of moving houses in Mumbai. Ray and Nikhat are excited about their new "adult" space, but the transition from the old house to the new one becomes a comedy of errors that tests their patience and their friendship.

programme.title: Work It Out
programme.desc: The episode explores the "Work-Life Balance" myth. Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed), now in a senior role with a fancy new apartment to pay for, is buried under deadlines, while Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) is trying to figure out how to be a "productive" freelancer without the structure of an office.

programme.title: Me Vs Us
programme.desc: The episode centers on the loss of personal space. As Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) spend more time in their new apartment, the "honeymoon phase" of moving in ends. The title reflects the struggle to maintain one’s own identity ("Me") while being part of a co-dependent duo ("Us").

programme.title: Not Cool
programme.desc: The episode centers on the arrival of Ray’s (Yashaswini Dayama) old school friend. Ray is excited to show off her "cool" Mumbai life, her "cool" roommate Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed), and her "cool" new apartment. However, the reunion doesn't go as planned, leading to a major case of "Social Comparison Anxiety."

programme.title: Challenge Accepted
programme.desc: Everything that could go wrong, does. The episode is a "comedy of errors" that quickly turns into an emotional crucible. As the girls juggle professional disasters and personal health scares, they are forced to answer the question: Are we just friends because it’s convenient, or are we family?

programme.title: Pawri Ho Rahi Hai
programme.desc: The episode picks up with Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) feeling the absolute peak of urban exhaustion. Between Nikhat’s soul-crushing corporate deadlines and Ray’s chaotic freelance schedule, they realize they are running on fumes. To blow off some steam before their planned trip home, they decide to have one last "epic" Mumbai night.

programme.title: Rat Trap
programme.desc: The episode follows Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) as they settle into their respective family homes. The initial "pampering phase" (where parents cook your favorite meals and do your laundry) ends abruptly, replaced by the suffocating routine and expectations they once ran away from.

programme.title: Old Dots, New Lines
programme.desc: While still in their respective hometowns, Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) encounter people from their past. The episode highlights the awkward friction that occurs when you realize your old friends have either stayed exactly the same or changed in ways you can no longer relate to.

programme.title: Sisterhood
programme.desc: The episode explores the complex, multi-generational layers of female relationships. It’s not just about the friendship between the two leads, but about the "sisterhood" they share with their mothers and the realization that their mothers were once young, ambitious, and confused women too.

programme.title: Out Of Office
programme.desc: The title "Out Of Office" is a play on their professional status, but it more accurately reflects their mental state. They’ve been "out of office" from their Mumbai lives for long enough to gain a new perspective. The episode focuses on the inevitable departure and the emotional weight of saying goodbye—this time with the maturity of adults who know exactly what they are going back to.

programme.title: Nero The Hero
programme.desc: The episode opens with a camera crew following Neerav Kapoor (Nero) as he prepares for his day. Within the first five minutes, it becomes clear that Nero doesn't just want to be an actor; he believes he is already a legendary craftsman who simply hasn't been "discovered" yet.

programme.title: The Tables Turn
programme.desc: The episode explores the concept of "Networking." Nero believes that his talent is so undeniable that if he can just get in front of the right person, the "tables will turn," and he will go from a nobody to a superstar. This leads him to infiltrate a high-profile industry event where he is, unsurprisingly, not fit.

programme.title: The Agony Aunt
programme.desc: Nero realizes that being a great actor isn't just about performing; it’s about observation and mentorship. He decides to take it upon himself to solve the "emotional blocks" of everyone around him, believing that his vast experience in playing fictional characters makes him an expert in real-world psychology.

programme.title: Superheroes
programme.desc: Nero becomes obsessed with the idea that he is the perfect fit for a "desi" superhero franchise. He doesn't wait for a script or a casting call; he decides to live the life of a superhero to "absorb the essence" of the character. This leads to some of the most cringeworthy "public" moments in the entire series.

programme.title: Getting Functional
programme.desc: Nero becomes convinced that the secret to becoming a superstar lies in "Physical Functionality." He decides that his body needs to be a fine-tuned instrument capable of any physical feat, leading him to join a CrossFit-style gym. However, in true Nero fashion, he doesn't just work out—he turns the gym into a stage for his "performative athleticism."

programme.title: In-House Talent
programme.desc: Nero is faced with a harsh reality: his bank account is empty, and his "blockbuster" hasn't arrived. He decides to grace a small-scale, in-house corporate production with his "legendary" presence. He views this as a charitable act—a superstar helping out the common folk—but the corporate team views him as a total nightmare.

programme.title: Reflections Of Blood
programme.desc: Nero decides that the mainstream industry is too "small-minded" to understand his vision. He takes on the role of Writer, Director, and Lead Actor to produce an avant-garde short film titled Reflections of Blood.

programme.title: Equal Rights
programme.desc: Nero realizes that "socially conscious" cinema is the current trend in the industry. He decides that to be a true "Hero," he needs to stand up for the marginalized. However, because it's Nero, he manages to turn a fight for "Equal Rights" into a self-centered campaign for "Actor’s Rights."

programme.title: High Is Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The title is a classic Nero-ism—a mangled version of "All's Well That Ends Well," infused with his obsession with "vibrations" and high-frequency living. In this finale, Nero is faced with the ultimate test: a real, high-stakes opportunity that requires him to be... normal.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The documentary crew follows a rare moment of "crisis" in Nero’s life. His landlord has had enough of the "acting workshops" (noise) and unpaid dues. Nero, however, refuses to see this as a tragedy; he views it as the "Second Act" of his biopic where the hero hits rock bottom before the inevitable rise.

programme.title: Respawn
programme.desc: Arun (Vishal Vashishtha) is a former professional gamer, once known as "Flickshot," who left his passion to work a monotonous corporate job and support his family. When he sees his former teammate, Shekhar, succeeding on a massive stage, his suppressed passion resurfaces. Despite his father’s disapproval and the general stigma surrounding gaming as a career, Arun decides to quit his job and attempt a comeback.

programme.title: When Your Bff Is Leaving School
programme.desc: The bittersweet countdown: the late chats, the “let’s do something memorable” mood, packing up memories, and the quiet fear of “will things be the same after you go?”

programme.title: If Your Wife Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A husband’s internal monologue meets the reality of his wife apparently reading his mind—every unspoken thought becomes a comedic disaster waiting to happen.

programme.title: School Best Friends During Lockdown
programme.desc: Online classes, missed canteen gossip, and the nostalgia of school friendships during isolation.

programme.title: When Girls Fall For Red Flags
programme.desc: A witty portrayal of how girls knowingly ignore every warning sign in relationships, convincing themselves that red flags are just “misunderstood.”

programme.title: When He Doesn’t Like You Back
programme.desc: You think maybe he does, you hope he might, you plan how you’ll act—but deep down you always know: the answer might be “no”; the video shows the sting of un-reciprocated feelings and how you deal.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Comes Home After A Long Time
programme.desc: The excitement, the over-preparing, the sibling rivalry resurfacing, and the joy of rediscovering the quirks you’d missed while they were away.

programme.title: Break-Up Ke Stages

programme.title: Love-Hate Relationship With Older Siblings
programme.desc: You fight, you compete, you annoy each other, you envy each other—but you also protect each other, share jokes, and there’s a lifelong bond underneath the push-and-pull.

programme.title: Silly Things We've All Heard In Our Childhood

programme.title: Struggles Of An Indian Bride
programme.desc: The emotional, logistical, and social pressures a bride faces — from family expectations to dress fittings, guest dramas, and internal doubts. The video underscores how “big day” dreams collide with reality.

programme.title: If Acp Pradyuman (cid) Were Your Boss
programme.desc: The video imagines ACP Pradyuman as a boss in an office setting. It highlights the dramatic style, quirky dialogues, and funny outcomes of his leadership.

programme.desc: With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Minnie's Surprise
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy are hired to babysit Clara Cluck's egg, but it begins to hatch on their watch! Follow as the Happy Helpers try to get the mama hen and her egg back together in time.

programme.title: Race For The Rigatoni Ribbon
programme.desc: Mickey and the gang head to Italy to compete in the Race for the Rigatoni Ribbon. Do the Roadster Racers have a chance at winning the race? Follow along with word-for-word narration to find out!

programme.title: A Hot-Dog Day
programme.desc: When Minnie plans a picnic for Daisy and friends, they all pitch in with the help of a misplaced basket.

programme.title: Minnie-rella
programme.desc: The fairy tale is based on the story of Cindrella. Minnie Mouse falls asleep while doing chores and dreams that she becomes Minnierella! She needs help to get ready for Prince Mickey's Grand Ball.

programme.title: Colors All Around
programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gane as they search for their favorite colors. Follow along with word-for-word narration and help them find all the colors in the rainbow!

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem
programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.
